Spherag Atlas API · Odoo Integration

📹 Videotutorial: Cómo usar el módulo

1) Connection (Remote Control)

Type: REST

Auth URL: https://api.spherag.com

Operations URL: https://apicore.spherag.com

connection_params (JSON):

{
  "username": "user@example.com",
  "password": "********",
  "system_id": 1401,
  "api_core_url": "https://apicore.spherag.com"
}
  • Get Token → performs POST /Authentication/Login and stores bag["access_token"].
  • Subsequent requests to apicore must include the header: Authorization: Bearer <access_token>.
  • Important: Token is NOT persisted. Each execution requires a new login.

2) Hierarchical Model

System (systemId)
└── Atlas (imei - physical device)
    └── AtlasElement (atlasElementId - sensor/component)
        └── ChartType (chartType - metric type)

3) Required Identifiers

  • systemId: Integer (example: 1401) - System identifier
  • imei: String (example: "865648060417847") - Atlas device identifier
  • atlasElementId: Integer (example: 4260) - Sensor identifier within Atlas
  • chartType: Integer (example: 8) - Historical metric type identifier

4) Discovery Endpoints

List Atlas devices:

GET https://apicore.spherag.com/systems/{systemId}/Atlas

Returns list of devices with their imei.

List Atlas Elements (sensors):

GET https://apicore.spherag.com/systems/{systemId}/Atlas/{imei}/AtlasElements

Returns list of sensors with id, name, type.

List Chart Types (metrics):

GET https://apicore.spherag.com/AtlasElement/Charts/{atlasElementId}

Returns available metrics: chartType, name.

5) Historical Data Endpoint

GET https://apicore.spherag.com/systems/{systemId}/Atlas/{imei}/AtlasElements/{atlasElementId}/monitoring
?ChartType={chartType}
&StartDate={timestamp_ms}
&EndDate={timestamp_ms}

Headers: Authorization: Bearer {access_token}

Parameters:

  • ChartType: Metric identifier
  • StartDate: Epoch timestamp in milliseconds
  • EndDate: Epoch timestamp in milliseconds

6) Response Formats

The API returns data in a structured object with different data types:

Response Structure:

{
  "atlasElementId": 8198,
  "batteryPercentage": 100,
  "signalPercentage": 100,
  "sensorData": {
    "data": [
      {
        "data": [
          {"value": [59.41, 66.98, 69.14], "dateTS": 1764670674425},
          {"value": [59.42, 67.02, 69.13], "dateTS": 1764670733890}
        ],
        "unitTypeId": 61,
        "symbol": "%"
      },
      {
        "data": [
          {"value": [10.65, 11.75, 12.41], "dateTS": 1764670674425},
          {"value": [10.66, 11.76, 12.42], "dateTS": 1764670733890}
        ],
        "unitTypeId": 27,
        "symbol": "ºC"
      }
    ]
  },
  "flowRateData": null,
  "accumulatedFlowData": null,
  "outputData": null,
  "digitalInputData": null
}

Data Types: sensorData, flowRateData, accumulatedFlowData, outputData, digitalInputData

Structure: Each data type contains arrays of variables, each with timestamped value arrays

7) Odoo Configuration

In Device (mdm.measurement.device):

{
  "system_id": 1401,
  "imei": "865648060417847",
  "start_date": "2025-01-01"
}
  • system_id: Spherag system identifier
  • imei: Atlas device identifier
  • start_date: Default start date for data retrieval

In Sensor (mdm.measurement.device.sensor):

{
  "atlas_element_id": 4260,
  "chart_type": 8,
  "start_date": "2025-01-01",
  "data_type": "sensor_data",
  "data_array_index": 0,
  "value_index": 0
}
  • atlas_element_id: Sensor identifier within the Atlas device
  • chart_type: Metric type identifier
  • start_date: Overrides device start date if provided
  • data_type: Type of data field (sensor_data, flow_rate_data, accumulated_flow_data, output_data, digital_input_data)
  • data_array_index: Index of the variable array (0=first variable like humidity, 1=second variable like temperature)
  • value_index: Position within the value array (0=10cm depth, 1=20cm depth, etc.)

8) Operational Flow

  1. Login → obtain access_token (not persisted)
  2. List Atlas devices for systemId (optional discovery)
  3. List AtlasElements for each imei (optional discovery)
  4. Get available chartTypes for each atlasElementId (optional discovery)
  5. Request historical data using time windows
  6. Persist last dateTS processed
  7. Finish execution (token is discarded)

9) Technical Requirements

  • Login required for each execution
  • Use only accessToken (refreshToken not used)
  • Timestamps in milliseconds (epoch)
  • Incremental ingestion by dateTS
  • Idempotent operations
  • Support multiple chartTypes per sensor
  • Adaptive parser for response format variations

import time from datetime import datetime
Remote = self.remote_id SensorModel = env['mdm.measurement.device.sensor']
plan = bag.get('sensors_plan') or [] access_token = bag.get('access_token')
if not access_token: raise Exception("Missing Spherag access_token in bag")
# Get API core URL from connection params cfg = {} try: cfg = json.loads(Remote.connection_params or '{}') except Exception: cfg = {}
api_core_url = (cfg.get('api_core_url') or 'https://apicore.spherag.com').rstrip('/') headers = { 'Authorization': 'Bearer %s' % access_token, 'Accept': 'application/json' }
final_date = fields.Date.today() window_start_suffix = ' 00:00:00' window_end_suffix = ' 23:59:59'
total_upserts = 0 total_errors = 0 items = []
for idx, sensor_plan in enumerate(plan, 1): sensor_id = sensor_plan['sensor_id'] device_id = sensor_plan['device_id'] system_id = sensor_plan['system_id'] imei = sensor_plan['imei'] atlas_element_id = sensor_plan['atlas_element_id'] chart_type = sensor_plan['chart_type'] data_type = sensor_plan.get('data_type', 'sensor_data') data_array_index = sensor_plan.get('data_array_index', 0) value_index = sensor_plan.get('value_index', 0) initial_date = sensor_plan['initial_date']
# Convert dates to epoch milliseconds try: start_dt = fields.Datetime.from_string(initial_date + window_start_suffix) end_dt = fields.Datetime.from_string(final_date + window_end_suffix) start_ts_ms = int(time.mktime(start_dt.timetuple()) * 1000) end_ts_ms = int(time.mktime(end_dt.timetuple()) * 1000) except Exception as e: items.append({ 'sensor_id': sensor_id, 'error': 'Date conversion error: %s' % str(e) }) continue
# Build URL - correct endpoint path url = '%s/systems/%s/Atlas/%s/AtlasElements/%s/monitoring?ChartType=%s&StartDate=%s&EndDate=%s' % ( api_core_url, system_id, imei, atlas_element_id, chart_type, start_ts_ms, end_ts_ms )
sensor_record = SensorModel.browse(sensor_id)
try: resp = request_retry('GET', url, headers=headers, timeout=timeout) code = resp.status_code full_url = getattr(resp, 'url', url)
if code < 400: payload = resp.json() or {}
# Validate payload is a dict (the new response structure) if not isinstance(payload, dict): items.append({ 'sensor_id': sensor_id, 'device_id': device_id, 'status': code, 'error': 'Invalid response format: expected dict, got %s' % type(payload).__name__, 'url': full_url }) continue
upserts = 0 errs = 0 readings_summary = [] window_start = initial_date + window_start_suffix window_end = final_date + window_end_suffix
# Map data_type to actual response field data_type_map = { 'sensor_data': 'sensorData', 'flow_rate_data': 'flowRateData', 'accumulated_flow_data': 'accumulatedFlowData', 'output_data': 'outputData', 'digital_input_data': 'digitalInputData' }
response_field = data_type_map.get(data_type, 'sensorData') data_container = payload.get(response_field)
if not data_container or not isinstance(data_container, dict): items.append({ 'sensor_id': sensor_id, 'device_id': device_id, 'status': code, 'error': 'No data in field: %s' % response_field, 'url': full_url, 'points_found': 0, 'upserts': 0, 'errors': 0 }) continue
# Get the data arrays data_arrays = data_container.get('data') or [] if not isinstance(data_arrays, list) or len(data_arrays) == 0: items.append({ 'sensor_id': sensor_id, 'device_id': device_id, 'status': code, 'error': 'Empty data arrays in %s' % response_field, 'url': full_url, 'points_found': 0, 'upserts': 0, 'errors': 0 }) continue
# Check if data_array_index is valid if data_array_index >= len(data_arrays): items.append({ 'sensor_id': sensor_id, 'device_id': device_id, 'status': code, 'error': 'data_array_index %s out of range (max: %s)' % (data_array_index, len(data_arrays) - 1), 'url': full_url, 'points_found': 0, 'upserts': 0, 'errors': 0 }) continue
# Get the specific variable array (e.g., humidity vs temperature) variable_array = data_arrays[data_array_index] if not isinstance(variable_array, dict): errs += 1 items.append({ 'sensor_id': sensor_id, 'device_id': device_id, 'status': code, 'error': 'Invalid variable array at index %s' % data_array_index, 'url': full_url, 'points_found': 0, 'upserts': 0, 'errors': 1 }) continue
# Get the timestamped data points time_series_data = variable_array.get('data') or [] if not isinstance(time_series_data, list): items.append({ 'sensor_id': sensor_id, 'device_id': device_id, 'status': code, 'error': 'No time series data in variable array', 'url': full_url, 'points_found': 0, 'upserts': 0, 'errors': 0 }) continue
# Process each timestamped data point for data_point in time_series_data: try: if not isinstance(data_point, dict): errs += 1 continue
# Extract timestamp date_ts_ms = data_point.get('dateTS') if date_ts_ms is None or date_ts_ms == '': errs += 1 if len(readings_summary) < 5: readings_summary.append({'error': 'Missing dateTS field'}) continue
# Convert from milliseconds to datetime try: ts_dt = datetime.fromtimestamp(int(date_ts_ms) / 1000.0) ts_str = ts_dt.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') except (ValueError, TypeError, OSError) as date_err: errs += 1 if len(readings_summary) < 5: readings_summary.append({'error': 'Invalid dateTS: %s' % str(date_err), 'dateTS': date_ts_ms}) continue
# Check if within window if not (window_start <= ts_str <= window_end): continue
# Extract value - can be array or single value raw_value = data_point.get('value')
if raw_value is None or raw_value == '': errs += 1 if len(readings_summary) < 5: readings_summary.append({'error': 'Missing value field', 'ts': ts_str}) continue
# Handle array values (sensor data with multiple depths/positions) if isinstance(raw_value, list): if len(raw_value) == 0: errs += 1 if len(readings_summary) < 5: readings_summary.append({'error': 'Empty value array', 'ts': ts_str}) continue
# Check if value_index is valid if value_index >= len(raw_value): errs += 1 if len(readings_summary) < 5: readings_summary.append({ 'error': 'value_index %s out of range (max: %s)' % (value_index, len(raw_value) - 1), 'ts': ts_str }) continue
# Get the specific value from the array value = raw_value[value_index] if value is None or value == '': errs += 1 if len(readings_summary) < 5: readings_summary.append({'error': 'Null value at index %s' % value_index, 'ts': ts_str}) continue # Handle single values (flow data, accumulated flow, etc.) else: value = raw_value
# Convert to float try: valf = float(value) except (ValueError, TypeError) as val_err: errs += 1 if len(readings_summary) < 5: readings_summary.append({'error': 'Invalid value format: %s' % str(val_err), 'value': str(value)[:50]}) continue
# Upsert reading Remote.upsert( 'mdm.measurement.device.sensor.reading', {'sensor_id': sensor_record.id, 'measurement_time': ts_str}, {'value': valf, 'device_id': device_id} ) upserts += 1
if len(readings_summary) < 5: readings_summary.append({ 'ts': ts_str, 'value': valf, 'data_type': data_type, 'array_idx': data_array_index, 'value_idx': value_index })
except Exception as e: errs += 1 if len(readings_summary) < 5: readings_summary.append({ 'error': str(e), 'raw_item': str(data_point)[:200] })
total_upserts += upserts total_errors += errs
items.append({ 'sensor_id': sensor_id, 'device_id': device_id, 'system_id': system_id, 'imei': imei, 'atlas_element_id': atlas_element_id, 'chart_type': chart_type, 'data_type': data_type, 'data_array_index': data_array_index, 'value_index': value_index, 'status': 200, 'url': full_url, 'points_found': len(time_series_data), 'upserts': upserts, 'errors': errs, 'readings': readings_summary, }) else: items.append({ 'sensor_id': sensor_id, 'device_id': device_id, 'status': code, 'error': (resp.text or '')[:400], 'url': full_url }) except Exception as e: items.append({ 'sensor_id': sensor_id, 'device_id': device_id, 'status': -1, 'error': str(e) })
# Rate limiting time.sleep(0.5)
# Create audit attachment audit = { 'executed_at': fields.Datetime.now(), 'final_date': final_date, 'total_upserts': total_upserts, 'total_errors': total_errors, 'items': items, }
b64 = base64.b64encode(json.dumps(audit, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2).encode('utf-8')) fname = 'spherag_readings_%s.json' % fields.Datetime.now().replace(':', '').replace('-', '').replace(' ', '_')
att = env['ir.attachment'].create({ 'name': fname, 'datas_fname': fname, 'datas': b64, 'mimetype': 'application/json', 'res_model': 'remotecontrol', 'res_id': Remote.id })
Remote.message_post( body=u"[Spherag] upserts=%s errors=%s" % (total_upserts, total_errors), attachment_ids=[att.id] )
bag['upserts'] = total_upserts bag['errors'] = total_errors bag['audit_attachment_id'] = att.id
